name: Greek Ground Turkey and Cauliflower Rice Casserole with Feta

fit.note: 499 cal sits mid-band (400-650); 11g total carbs well under the 35g cap; ground turkey scales by weigh-and-divide; budget meal-prep casserole.

Neither is the same dinner.

Could collide with a chicken or beef version of the same plate in another selector's pool (e.g. 'Greek chicken cauliflower feta casserole' or a Greek ground-beef cauliflower-feta bake): same cauliflower-rice + feta + Greek-seasoning skeleton with the protein swapped. Decider should check the chicken and beef pools for a same-dish-different-protein twin.
